QUOTE: A field declared as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` is really named `private_nr`, so `ctx.nr` fails to compile.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says opacity is enforced at compile time by renaming the member to `private_x`, so the access fails to compile. It doesn't say the struct layout is hidden, and it presents the renamed field as a normal member of the struct.
